note: Curated starter recipes for the AI's knowledge base. Calories and protein are per serving and approximate. Diets: vegan implies vegetarian and pescatarian, vegetarian implies pescatarian (the build script adds those).

items.title: Masala Omelette
steps: Whisk eggs with turmeric, salt, onion, tomato, chilli and coriander.
Heat oil in a pan on medium.
Pour in the eggs and cook 2 minutes until the base sets.
Fold and cook 1 more minute.

items.title: Chana Masala
ingredients: 1.5 tsp chana masala or garam masala
steps: Fry onion in oil 8 minutes until golden.
Add ginger-garlic paste, cook 1 minute.
Add spices and tomato puree, cook 6 minutes until oil separates.
Add chickpeas and 1 cup water, simmer 15 minutes, mashing a few chickpeas to thicken.
Finish with lemon juice and coriander.

items.title: Dal Tadka (Yellow Lentil Dal)
ingredients: 1 cup toor or moong dal, rinsed
2 tbsp oil (or ghee if not vegan)
steps: Boil dal with turmeric and 3 cups water 20–25 minutes (or 3 pressure-cooker whistles) until soft.
Heat oil, add cumin, garlic and red chillies for 1 minute.
Add onion 5 minutes, then tomato 4 minutes.
Pour the tadka into the dal, salt to taste, simmer 3 minutes.

items.title: Paneer Bhurji
steps: Cook onion and chilli in butter 4 minutes.
Add tomato and spices, cook 3 minutes.
Add paneer, stir 3 minutes until hot.
Top with coriander.

items.title: Palak Paneer
ingredients: 1 tsp cumin seeds, 1/2 tsp garam masala
steps: Blanch spinach 2 minutes, cool in cold water, blend smooth.
Fry cumin and onion in oil 6 minutes, add ginger-garlic 1 minute.
Add spinach puree and garam masala, simmer 5 minutes.
Add paneer and cream, simmer 3 minutes.

items.title: Vegetable Pulao
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice, rinsed and soaked 20 minutes
1 bay leaf, 4 cloves, 2 cardamom, 1 tsp cumin
steps: Fry whole spices in oil 30 seconds, add onion 5 minutes.
Add vegetables 2 minutes.
Add drained rice, water and salt, bring to a boil.
Cover and cook on low 12 minutes, rest 5 minutes, fluff.

items.title: Kanda Poha
steps: Rinse poha in a sieve until soft, drain 5 minutes.
Fry peanuts in oil 2 minutes, add mustard seeds and curry leaves.
Add onion 4 minutes, then turmeric.
Add poha and salt, toss 3 minutes on low, finish with lemon and coriander.

items.title: Rava Upma
steps: Dry-roast semolina 5 minutes until fragrant, set aside.
Fry mustard seeds, curry leaves, chilli, ginger and onion in oil 4 minutes; add vegetables.
Add water and salt, bring to a boil.
Stream in semolina while stirring, cook 3 minutes covered on low.

items.title: Home-style Chicken Curry
ingredients: 1 tsp each turmeric, chilli powder, coriander powder, garam masala
steps: Fry onions in oil 10 minutes until deep golden.
Add ginger-garlic paste 1 minute, then powdered spices 30 seconds.
Add tomato, cook 6 minutes; stir in yogurt.
Add chicken, sear 5 minutes, add 1 cup water, simmer covered 20 minutes until chicken reaches 74°C/165°F.
Finish with garam masala and coriander.

items.title: Tandoori Chicken Traybake
ingredients: 2 tsp tandoori masala, 1 tsp chilli powder
1 onion and 1 pepper, cut in chunks
steps: Mix yogurt, paste, spices, lemon, oil and salt; coat chicken and marinate at least 30 minutes (overnight is best).
Heat oven to 220°C/430°F.
Spread chicken and vegetables on a lined tray.
Roast 25–30 minutes until charred at the edges and 74°C/165°F inside.

items.title: Egg Fried Rice
ingredients: 3 cups cold cooked rice (day-old works best)
2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp sesame oil
steps: Scramble eggs in a very hot wok with 1/2 tbsp oil, remove.
Add remaining oil, garlic and vegetables, stir-fry 2 minutes.
Add rice, press and toss 3–4 minutes until hot and slightly crisp.
Return eggs, add soy sauce, sesame oil and spring onions, toss 1 minute.

items.title: Chicken and Vegetable Stir-fry
ingredients: 2 garlic cloves and 1 tsp ginger, minced
2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp oyster or hoisin sauce
1 tsp cornflour mixed with 3 tbsp water
steps: Sear chicken in a very hot pan with oil 4–5 minutes until cooked through, remove.
Stir-fry vegetables, garlic and ginger 3 minutes so they stay crisp.
Return chicken, add sauces and cornflour slurry.
Toss 1 minute until glossy; serve with rice or noodles.

items.title: Crispy Tofu Stir-fry
ingredients: 400g firm tofu, pressed 10 minutes and cubed
2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp maple syrup or sugar, 1 tsp rice vinegar
steps: Toss tofu in cornflour and a pinch of salt.
Fry in oil 8–10 minutes, turning, until golden on all sides; remove.
Stir-fry vegetables, garlic and ginger 3 minutes.
Add sauce and tofu, toss 1 minute.

items.title: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
steps: Cook spaghetti in well-salted boiling water until 1 minute short of the packet time; save 1 cup pasta water.
Meanwhile warm oil with garlic on low 3–4 minutes until pale gold (don't brown), add chilli.
Add pasta and a splash of pasta water, toss hard 1 minute to make a glossy sauce.
Finish with parsley.

items.title: Tomato Basil Pasta
steps: Cook pasta in salted water; save 1/2 cup water.
Soften garlic in oil 1 minute, add tomatoes, sugar and salt.
Simmer 10 minutes until thick.
Toss in pasta, pasta water, basil and parmesan.

items.title: Creamy Mushroom Pasta
steps: Cook pasta in salted water; save 1/2 cup water.
Brown mushrooms in butter on high 6 minutes without stirring too often.
Add garlic and thyme 1 minute, then cream and a splash of pasta water.
Toss with pasta and parmesan, season with pepper.

items.title: Lemon Garlic Salmon
steps: Pat salmon dry and season.
Sear skin-side down in hot oil 4 minutes, flip, cook 2–3 minutes until it flakes (63°C/145°F).
Add butter, garlic and lemon juice to the pan for 30 seconds, spoon over fish.
Serve with greens or rice.

items.title: Tuna Pasta Salad
steps: Cook pasta, rinse under cold water, drain well.
Mix yogurt, mayo, lemon, salt and pepper.
Fold in pasta, tuna and vegetables.
Keeps 3 days in the fridge.

items.title: Garlic Butter Prawns
steps: Pat prawns dry and season.
Melt butter on medium-high, add garlic and chilli 30 seconds.
Add prawns, cook 1.5–2 minutes per side until pink and opaque.
Finish with lemon and parsley.

items.title: Greek Salad
ingredients: 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp red wine vinegar, dried oregano
steps: Combine vegetables and olives.
Whisk oil, vinegar, oregano, salt and pepper.
Dress the salad and top with the feta.

items.title: Lemony Chickpea Salad
steps: Rinse and drain chickpeas.
Dice the vegetables and herbs.
Whisk oil, lemon juice, cumin and salt.
Toss everything; it keeps 3 days.

items.title: Red Lentil Soup
steps: Soften onion, carrot and garlic in oil 6 minutes.
Add spices 30 seconds, then lentils, tomatoes and stock.
Simmer 20 minutes until lentils collapse.
Blend partly or fully; finish with lemon and salt.

items.title: Roasted Tomato Soup
steps: Roast tomatoes, onion and garlic with oil and salt at 200°C/400°F for 30 minutes.
Blend with stock and basil.
Simmer 5 minutes and season.

items.title: Overnight Oats
ingredients: 1/2 cup milk (any; use plant milk and plant yogurt for vegan)
steps: Stir oats, milk, yogurt, chia and sweetener in a jar.
Refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight.
Top with fruit; keeps 3 days.

items.title: Banana Oat Pancakes
ingredients: pinch of cinnamon and baking powder
steps: Blend banana, eggs, oats, cinnamon and baking powder.
Rest batter 3 minutes.
Cook small pancakes in a lightly oiled pan on medium-low 2 minutes per side.

items.title: Greek Yogurt Protein Parfait
steps: Layer yogurt, berries and granola in a glass.
Top with nuts and honey; eat right away so the granola stays crunchy.

items.title: Avocado Toast with Egg
steps: Toast the bread.
Mash avocado with lemon and salt, spread on toast.
Fry or poach the egg (3 minutes for a runny yolk) and place on top; add chilli flakes.

items.title: Chicken Burrito Bowl
ingredients: 1 tbsp taco seasoning (cumin, paprika, chilli, garlic)
steps: Rub chicken with seasoning and oil.
Cook in a hot pan 5–6 minutes per side to 74°C/165°F, rest 5 minutes, slice.
Warm beans and corn.
Build bowls: rice, beans, corn, chicken, salsa, lettuce and lime.

items.title: Black Bean Tacos
steps: Warm beans with spices and a splash of water 5 minutes, mash lightly.
Char tortillas in a dry pan 30 seconds per side.
Fill with beans, avocado, onion, cabbage and salsa; finish with lime.

items.title: Shakshuka
ingredients: 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp paprika, pinch of chilli
steps: Soften onion and pepper in oil 7 minutes, add garlic and spices 1 minute.
Add tomatoes, simmer 8 minutes until thick.
Make 4 wells, crack in eggs, cover and cook on low 5–7 minutes until whites set.
Top with parsley or feta.

items.title: Cauliflower Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 medium cauliflower, grated or pulsed into rice
1/2 cup peas and carrot (skip for strict keto)
2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp sesame oil
steps: Scramble eggs in oil, remove.
Stir-fry garlic and vegetables 2 minutes.
Add cauliflower rice, cook on high 5 minutes until tender but not mushy.
Add eggs, soy, sesame oil and spring onions.

items.title: Zucchini Noodles with Pesto
steps: Pat zucchini noodles dry with a towel.
Toss in a hot pan 2 minutes only, so they don't go watery.
Off the heat, toss with pesto and tomatoes.
Top with pine nuts and parmesan.

items.title: Stuffed Sweet Potatoes with Black Beans
steps: Prick potatoes and bake at 200°C/400°F for 45 minutes (or microwave 8–10 minutes) until soft.
Warm beans and corn with spices 5 minutes.
Split potatoes and fill with beans, salsa, lime and coriander.

items.title: Keema Matar (Spiced Mince with Peas)
ingredients: 500g lean lamb, mutton or chicken mince
1 tsp each cumin, coriander powder, garam masala, chilli
steps: Fry onions in oil 8 minutes, add ginger-garlic 1 minute.
Add mince, break it up and brown 6 minutes.
Add spices and tomatoes, cook 5 minutes.
Add peas and 1/2 cup water, simmer 12 minutes until mince is cooked through (71°C/160°F).

items.title: Rajma (Kidney Bean Curry)
ingredients: 2 cans (800g) kidney beans, drained (or 1 cup dried, soaked overnight and boiled hard)
1 tsp cumin seeds, 1 tsp each chilli and coriander powder, 1/2 tsp garam masala
steps: Fry cumin and onions in oil 8 minutes, add ginger-garlic 1 minute.
Add powdered spices and tomato puree, cook 8 minutes.
Add beans and 2 cups water, simmer 20 minutes, mashing a few beans for body.
Finish with garam masala; serve with rice.

items.title: Classic Hummus
steps: Blend tahini and lemon 1 minute until fluffy.
Add chickpeas, garlic, cumin and salt, blend.
Stream in 2–4 tbsp ice water or chickpea liquid until very smooth.
Top with olive oil and paprika.

items.title: 2-Minute Mug Brownie
ingredients: pinch of salt, a few chocolate chips
steps: Mix everything in a large mug until smooth.
Microwave 60–80 seconds; the centre should look slightly fudgy.
Rest 1 minute before eating.

items.title: Mango Lassi
steps: Blend everything until smooth and frothy.
Taste and adjust sweetness; serve cold.
